summary: CalTrans is identified as a co-funder of the study (providing 18% of costs via Proposition 5 fixed guideway funds) and as a participant in both the Inter-Agency Coordinating Committee (IACC) and the Interagency Technical Committee (ITC). The LARTS branch of CalTrans also provided major technical assistance in patronage forecasting. CalTrans is also noted as separately responsible for a Freeway Transit Project (Bus/HOV-ways) that is one of the other elements of the Regional Transportation Development Program, but no position for or against any of the eleven alternatives is attributed to CalTrans in this window.
